processes.name: web server

assumptions.assumption: The web server is internet-facing because it serves the public site.
assumptions.basis: The source describes it as serving the public site and says readers hit it.

assumptions.assumption: The MySQL database is confidential because it stores accounts and comments in addition to site pages.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the database contains pages, accounts and comments; accounts and comments may contain information whose disclosure harms people or the business.

assumptions.assumption: The CDN bucket contains public data because readers fetch the assets from the CDN as part of the public site.
assumptions.basis: The source says the site is public and that readers fetch images, stylesheets and downloads from the CDN.

assumptions.assumption: The CDN is a tenant trust zone distinct from the hosted network because it is described as a separate CDN service and bucket.
assumptions.basis: The source describes assets being pushed from the web server to the CDN's bucket, indicating a separately controlled service zone.
